text: 万科A公告，A股股票连续三个交易日（2026年9月18日、9月21日、9月22日）收盘价格涨幅偏离值累计超过20%。公司表示近期经营情况稳定，房地产板块上市公司股票交易活跃；经核查，公司及第一大股东不存在应披露而未披露的重大事项，异常波动期间第一大股东未主动买卖公司股票。
text_en: China Vanke A announced that the closing price deviation of its A-shares exceeded 20% cumulatively over three consecutive trading days (September 18, September 21, and September 22, 2026). The company stated that its recent operating conditions have been stable, and trading in stocks of listed companies in the real estate sector has been active; upon verification, neither the company nor its largest shareholder has any major undisclosed matters that should be disclosed, and the largest shareholder did not actively buy or sell the company's shares during the period of abnormal fluctuation.
